courses.summary: A B.Sc. in Computer Science is a science-faculty bachelor's degree in the theory and practice of computing. The curriculum covers programming, data structures and algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, operating systems, databases, networks and software engineering, with electives in artificial intelligence, data science, cyber security or graphics. universities.summary: Thiagarajar College is an arts, science and commerce college on Kamarajar Salai, Madurai, affiliated to Madurai Kamaraj University. Aided and self-financed programmes have separate admission choices and fee arrangements. Confirm the current timetable, activities and support available for the selected degree and stream.
universities.cityProfile: The college is at 139–140 Kamarajar Salai, Teppakulam, Madurai 625009, Tamil Nadu. Plan commuting or accommodation around this specific campus. Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Thiagarajar College of Preceptors and Thiagarajar School of Management are separate institutions with their own admissions.
universities.practicalExposure: The prospectus describes practical laboratories, academic projects, student activities and application-oriented learning within the subject departments. Requirements vary by degree, and Chemistry lists different ancillary-paper routes. Confirm the current curriculum and practical arrangements; admission does not guarantee an internship, job or professional qualification.
universities.hostelOverview: College hostel accommodation is limited and requires a separate application to the Warden after academic admission. universities.dietarySupport: Confirm mess services, charges and support for allergies or medical diets directly before accepting accommodation. A particular meal plan or individual dietary arrangement has not been established for these entries. Budget for food separately unless the college supplies an inclusive quotation.
universities.safetyOverview: The prospectus describes an anti-ragging committee, an Internal Complaints Committee and student-welfare contacts. Obtain their current details and the applicable reporting procedures when enrolling. Discuss individual travel, health and accessibility requirements directly; committee existence does not guarantee a personal safety outcome.
universities.studentSupport: The college describes library resources, academic departments, student activities, scholarships and support services. Confirm what applies to the selected programme and individual circumstances. Scholarship eligibility, documentary requirements, hostel availability and other benefits need separate checks; academic admission does not establish an entitlement.

faq.question: Which Thiagarajar institution is this?
faq.answer: This is Thiagarajar College at 139–140 Kamarajar Salai, Teppakulam, Madurai 625009, affiliated to Madurai Kamaraj University. The engineering college, College of Preceptors and School of Management have separate identities and admissions.

faq.question: Which routes are covered?
faq.answer: These entries cover regular domestic academic undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. Aided and self-financed routes remain separate; professional, research and overseas routes need their own checks.

faq.question: How long are these degrees?
faq.answer: The undergraduate programme tables specify three years and six semesters. The postgraduate tables specify two years and four semesters. B.Com. Honours is listed within the three-year undergraduate framework.

faq.question: What school subjects are required?
faq.answer: Requirements differ by programme. The published tables identify language, commerce, mathematics, science and computing conditions. Check the exact combination and any ancillary-paper choice directly with the college.

faq.question: What is required for postgraduate admission?
faq.answer: Use the exact qualifying-degree route for the selected master’s programme. Some accept a specified bachelor’s subject while others list broader degree routes. Undergraduate entry conditions do not establish postgraduate eligibility.

faq.question: What teaching medium is known?
faq.answer: The prospectus identifies aided Economics as Tamil medium and self-financed Economics as English medium. Confirm other programmes directly; degree names and language-paper choices alone do not establish teaching medium.

faq.question: How should I interpret fees?
faq.answer: Request the current itemised schedule for the exact degree and stream. Reported semester tuition figures are indicative and do not include all laboratory, deposit, examination, accommodation or personal costs.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Use the college’s notified online admission links, register your own email and select the exact programme and stream. Complete the information and payments, then follow any provisional selection and original-document instructions.

faq.question: Is hostel accommodation guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The prospectus states that accommodation is limited and requires a separate application to the Warden after college admission. Confirm room availability, charges and mess arrangements independently.

faq.question: What does the CMA-integrated M.Com. title mean for applicants?
faq.answer: The college lists an M.Com. (CMA Integrated) route with B.Com. eligibility. Confirm the accompanying professional-study component, its examinations and charges; an academic admission does not establish an external professional qualification.
